title: Check Homework
simplified_paragraphs: 有一天，妈妈陪着她六岁的女儿学习。
女儿突然说：“妈妈，你真幸福，都不用做作业。”妈妈回答：“那我帮你写作业，你来检查，好吗？”女儿高兴地答应了。
检查作业时，女儿把作业都做了一遍。
traditional_paragraphs: 有一天，媽媽陪著她六歲的女兒學習。
女兒突然說：“媽媽，你真幸福，都不用做作業。”媽媽回答：“那我幫你寫作業，你來檢查，好嗎？”女兒高興地答應了。
檢查作業時，女兒把作業都做了一遍。
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yì tiān， mā ma péi zhe tā liù suì de nǚ ér xué xí。
nǚ ér tū rán shuō：“ mā ma， nǐ zhēn xìng fú， dōu bù yòng zuò zuò yè。” mā ma huí dá：“ nà wǒ bāng nǐ xiě zuò yè， nǐ lái jiǎn chá， hǎo ma？” nǚ ér gāo xìng de dā ying le。
jiǎn chá zuò yè shí， nǚ ér bǎ zuò yè dōu zuò le yī biàn。
english_paragraphs: One day, a mother sat with her six-year-old daughter while she studied.
The daughter suddenly said, “Mom, you’re so lucky. You don’t have to do homework.” Her mother replied, “How about I do your homework, and you check it?” The daughter happily agreed.
But when she checked the homework, the daughter ended up doing every problem herself.
english_full:
One day, a mother sat with her six-year-old daughter while she studied.

The daughter suddenly said, “Mom, you’re so lucky. You don’t have to do homework.” Her mother replied, “How about I do your homework, and you check it?” The daughter happily agreed.

But when she checked the homework, the daughter ended up doing every problem herself.
